rules.description: a commit on the PR branch by a person with no run attempt in the window -- the cherry-pick of a handover ref that the land node should have pushed
a review-fix/* side branch deleted by hand -- the cleanup node should have removed it after pr.merged
an operator reply posted by hand on a review thread the loop fixed -- the land node should have replied and resolved it
an ssh checkout reset noted in an issue comment before a dispatch (#286)

notes: First definition, written from PR #307's measured hand-turns (three per the counting rule, eight review-fix branches, the a029689 cherry-pick). Iterate this record -- supersede it -- from what the observer proposes wrongly; do not edit the observer.
